text:

Monday, January 28, 2019
Q4 Earnings Update
This will be a very important week for earnings results, especially in the Tech industry: Apple AAPL reports Tuesday after the market closes - and recall the company had warned to the downside a few weeks ago, for the first time in recent memory - followed by Facebook FB and Microsoft MSFT on Wednesday and Amazon AMZN Thursday.
This morning, the market is paying close attention to industrial equipment major Caterpillar CAT , which has disappointed expectations on both top and bottom lines. Earnings of $2.55 per share missed the Zacks consensus $2.98 by more than 14%, while sales of $14.34 billion marginally came up short of expectations. Guidance was also found a tad wanting.
Zacks Rank #4 (Sell-)-rated Bank of Hawaii BOH
Mark Vickery
Senior Editor
